superseded_formation_receipt.false_claim: The receipt reported byte-identical replay, but that test reused the checked-in output path and did not test an arbitrary output target.

defect.cause: The v2 generator derives replay.command from the live --output argument and serializes that command into the artifact. Identical authenticated inputs therefore produce different artifact bytes at a different output path.
defect.comparison: The compact payload digest remains equal because replay is appended after the payload digest. The serialized replay.command is the material difference; path length changes the final artifact byte count and raw SHA-256.

disposition.retained_evidence: The fail-closed counts and content-addressed discovery evidence may be recut only in a new version with this withdrawal attached.

next: Cut occurrence-owner-formation-v3 with output-path-independent serialized bytes, prove byte identity at arbitrary temporary output paths, then require two fresh challenges and root gestalt.
